scenario.note: Two relative limits: one on the proportion of total units made, and one on the relationship between total units sold and total units in stock.
Rules bound the SUM of a decision measure over a scope; a relative rule compares two such sums.
A relative rule compares the sum of make in June to the sum of make in March.
A relative rule compares the sum of make over June to the sum of make over March.
A rule enforces that total units in stock in the last month is at least 3 times total units made in the same month.
The rule enforces that the total stock in the last month is at least three times the total production in the same month.
